product_truth.assertion: The checkout is a local simulation and cannot charge or submit an order.
product_truth.observable_test: No network or payment request occurs; receipt says simulation only.

derived_values.assertion: Line-item total and review total derive from the same basket records.
derived_values.observable_test: Changing quantity updates item, summary, review, and receipt totals consistently.

identity_invariants.assertion: Each basket record has one stable unique ID across edit and review states.
identity_invariants.observable_test: Edit-back-edit preserves the same item IDs.

required_states.visible_result: Three items and editable quantities are visible.

required_states.entry: activate Review order after fulfillment is complete
required_states.visible_result: Exact items, fulfillment choice, total, edit paths, and simulated commitment are visible.

required_states.entry: activate Place simulated order from review
required_states.visible_result: A truthful local-only receipt and next action are visible.

effect_boundary.external_effects: None; all state stays in the local page.
effect_boundary.confirmation: The final control names the simulated order and follows a review step.
effect_boundary.truthful_receipt: Receipt states that no payment or order was sent.

narrow_width.overflow_test: documentElement.scrollWidth must not exceed clientWidth at 320 and 375 CSS pixels.
